### Appendix 1
Vowel midpoints of pseudoword stimuli produced by talker (Bark scale). Each pseudoword was produced four times. 
```{r}
# Normalized F1 x F2 (Bark scale) of all stimulus items produced by talker in training
p_o5_norm <- ggplot(d_o5, aes(x=F2_Bark, y=F1_Bark, label=item)) + 
  theme_bw(base_size=12)+geom_text()+scale_x_reverse()+scale_y_reverse()+xlab("normalized F2")+ylab("normalized F1")+
  ggtitle("")+theme(legend.position = 'none')

p_o5_norm2 <- p_o5_norm + scale_x_reverse(
  limits = c(13,7),
  breaks = c(13,12,11,10,9,8,7),
  labels = c("13","","11","","9","","7")
) + scale_y_reverse(
  limits = c(8,3),
  breaks = c(8,7,6,5,4,3),
  labels = c("", "7", "", "5", "", "3")
)+theme_bw(base_size=11) + theme(legend.position = 'none') + xlab("Normalized F2")+ylab("Normalized F1")
  #ggtitle("Talker Vowel Plot (Bark) - All Stimulus Items")
#+ stat_ellipse(aes(linetype=grapheme_typed2))
#p_o4_norm
p_o5_norm2

```

### Appendix 2
Dictation responses by vowel item.
```{r}

div_bar <- ggplot(div_count, aes(x=item, y=n,fill=vowel_letter_4way))+
  geom_bar(stat="identity",position="stack",width=0.9) +
  theme_minimal() +
  #ggtitle("Dictation vowel letter responses by item")+
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45,vjust=1,hjust=1),legend.position="bottom",axis.text=element_text(size=11))+
  labs(fill= "Vowel Letter",x="Item")+
  scale_fill_brewer(palette="Set2")
div_bar

```

## Appendix 3

```{r}

kable(
  m_table_select,
  col.names = c("Predictors", "Estimate", "SE", "p"),
  digits = 3,
  longtable = T,
  caption = "Old/New: Proportion Old responses by Match (to response in Dictation) and Button Order",
  booktabs = T
  ) %>%
  row_spec(0,italic = TRUE) %>%
  kable_styling()


```
